run.title: Quiet-by-Design Standards for MWAA Terminals
run.thesis: MWAA should establish a common quiet-by-design standard for new and substantially renovated terminal spaces at IAD and DCA because acoustics, public-address zoning, information systems, and operational controls are more effective and less costly when specified before designs and procurements harden. However, “quiet” should not be defined simply as fewer announcements: the standard must preserve safety, accessibility, operational resilience, and passenger confidence through intelligible localized audio and redundant visual, digital, and staffed communication. The central question is which requirements should be mandatory across both airports, which should vary by terminal and operating context, and how MWAA should measure compliance and performance.
